lines.en: -Leslie, thanks to your annoying prying last year,
I'm sure you remember my birthday's coming up.
-I know, I know. No parties. You hate parties.
Oh, you know that wild goose chase
you sent Ben on for Valentine's Day?
-I absolutely do not want to solve a series of riddles and clues,
each more intricate than the last.
-Oh, I do want that. Please do that for me.
